continuity: Wolhwa can issue mobilization orders to more than thirty Lower District Sect branches across Shanxi Province.
Forty-seven mounted bandits survived the battle; the Lower District Sect can save only about thirty with its current medicine, and the survivors will ultimately be sold as labor or arena slaves.
The Lower District Sect is spreading the claim that Jin Taekyung and Jin Mukyung defeated Pung Yang and rescued the Mount Heng Sword Sect so the remaining mounted bandits will withdraw.
Two days have passed since Lee Seowol proposed marriage, and she has not returned; Taekyung has decided to reject the proposal.
Taekyung loves Song Song and considers marriage to Lee Seowol impossible despite the offered martial arts.
Jin Mukyung recovered sufficiently after his injuries to move around without assistance.
Taekyung is spending most of his time learning to control his newly acquired Scorching Yang Qi.
plot: Wolhwa directs the Lower District Sect's Jeongyang and Honju branches in the aftermath of the battle. Forty-seven mounted bandits survived, but the available medicine can save only about thirty; the rest will die or later be sold into slavery. The Lower District Sect begins spreading a favorable rumor that the two Jin brothers defeated Pung Yang and rescued the Mount Heng Sword Sect, expecting the Jin Family of Taiyuan to force the remaining bandits back to the plateau within five days.

Wolhwa investigates Pung Yang's sudden increase in strength and reflects on her Master's advice to observe people who defy prediction. She then visits Jin Taekyung's pavilion, where Hyuk Mujin reports that Taekyung has been muttering incomprehensible modern-world terms. Hearing Taekyung repeat “school lunch, high schooler, clank, clank,” Wolhwa withdraws, once again judging him completely unpredictable.

Two days later, Taekyung has spent most of his time learning to control his newly acquired Scorching Yang Qi. Lee Seowol has not returned after proposing marriage, and Taekyung decides to reject her because she is seventeen, the proposal is political, and he loves Song Song. Jin Mukyung has recovered enough to move independently; when Taekyung reveals that the proposal included the Blood Wolf Sword Technique, Blood Wolf Footwork, and Shura Annihilating Fist, Mukyung immediately orders him to marry her.
translation_decisions: Render 총지부장 as Chief Branch Leader, 정양지부장 as Jeongyang Branch Leader, and 혼주지부장 as Honju Branch Leader.
Render 급식 as school lunch, 고딩 as high schooler, and 철컹, 철컹 as clank, clank; preserve the implication that this talk about a high schooler could lead to imprisonment in a footnote.
Render 인륜지대사 as one of life's great human obligations and retain Jaringobi with an explanatory footnote for the miser-and-dried-fish reference.

active_continuity: Pung Yang is dead; Jin Taekyung killed him after the Unnamed Sword's Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron destroyed his Body-Protecting Qi and pierced his chest.
Taekyung fully absorbed the Blazing Flame Divine Pill and possesses forty-five years of internal energy with the Scorching Yang Qi attribute.
Jin Mukyung survived his fight with Pung Yang and has recovered enough to move independently.
Cheol Mubaek and the other wounded Mount Heng martial artists are recovering after receiving treatment.
Lee Seowol remains the Sect Leader of the Mount Heng Sword Sect and vows to preserve the sect for those who died defending it.
The Lower District Sect sent a relief force with physicians, cooks, and laborers after the battle.
Wolhwa's real name is Eun Sowol, and she is the Lower District Sect's Shanxi Branch Leader with authority over more than thirty Shanxi branches.
Lee Seowol accepted Jin Wikyung's invitation to the Jin Family of Taiyuan's New Year gathering.
Lee Seowol offered the Mount Heng Sword Sect's territorial rights to the Jin Family of Taiyuan as an apology.
Lee Seowol proposed marriage to Jin Taekyung in exchange for the Blood Wolf Sword Technique, Blood Wolf Footwork, and Shura Annihilating Fist.
Lee Seowol is seventeen years old.
Jin Taekyung has decided to reject Lee Seowol's political marriage proposal because of her age and because he loves Song Song.
Forty-seven mounted bandits survived the battle, but the Lower District Sect can save only about thirty with its available medicine.
The Lower District Sect is spreading a rumor that the two Jin brothers defeated Pung Yang and rescued the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
open_questions: How will the Jin Family of Taiyuan respond to Lee Seowol's proposed transaction and territorial transfer?
Can Lee Seowol preserve or rebuild the Mount Heng Sword Sect with so few survivors?
What is the origin and full long-term effect of the Temporary Strength Pill?
What consequences will Pung Yang's death have for the Red Wind Band and the wider Murim?

Render 뛰어난 금창약 as Superior Wound Medicine and 십년하수오 as Ten-Year He Shouwu.
Render 완전 회복 as Full Recovery and 회광반조 as final rally in this death-and-recovery context.
